comment: Composite indexes and TTL policies required by the referral system.
Firestore creates single-field indexes automatically, so only queries that
combine an equality filter with an ordering or range on a different field
appear here. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
The fieldOverrides below declare the TTL policies, so they deploy with the
indexes rather than having to be clicked into the Firebase console. Click
rows are what make the system forget visitors who never created an
account, so a missing TTL here is a privacy regression, not a tidiness one.
`deleteAfter` is written and never queried, so each override also drops
that field's automatic single-field indexes ("indexes": []), which is
what Firestore recommends for a pure TTL marker.
This file is the project's complete index manifest, not just the referral
system's. The pre-existing watchProgress index is listed first because
`firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes` treats the file as the full
desired state and offers to delete live indexes missing from it — an
omission here is a deletion prompt against a working query later.
